newsitem.title: USA: US W.Coast refined products gain amid supply worry.
newsitem.headline: US W.Coast refined products gain amid supply worry.

text.p: U.S. West Coast refined product prices rose Monday amid broader market gains and concerns about tighter supplies in the region, traders said.
Unconfirmed rumors of refinery problems in San Francisco forced bidders to raise prices as they looked for sellers.
But the concerns of thin supplies remained speculative, with other traders claiming units had returned from shutdowns last week.
State-mandated prompt CARB gasoline in Los Angeles was heard traded between 62.50 and 63.50 cents a gallon, while regular unleaded gasoline was seen at 59.00 to 60 cents.
A shipment of CARB gasoline in Los Angeles was traded 62.25 cents a gallon.
On the NYMEX, August gasoline firmed 0.81 cent to finish at 64.84 cents a gallon and August heating oil edged up 0.15 cent to 54.14 cents a gallon.
